cause: Slave daemon registered SecretsService but omitted it from its ProjectService factory. Declared appEnv vault references therefore refused stack start.
scope: Wire the existing local encrypted vault into slave ProjectService; audit/fleet remain master-only.
negativeControls: Original three-argument factory still refuses app-env references without a vault
Missing or empty entries still refuse startup; no empty-secret fallback
runtimeEffect: No credential creation, rotation, serialization or transport change.
